title: Peregrine falcon
answer: The peregrine falcon is the fastest animal alive, reaching dive speeds above 320 km/h. It uses a teardrop dive profile to minimize drag.

title: Puffin
answer: Atlantic puffins can carry up to 60 fish at once. Their beaks glow under UV light, which may help attract mates.

title: Owls
answer: Owls have asymmetrical ears, which lets them locate prey in complete darkness. They can rotate their heads up to 270 degrees.

title: Hummingbirds
answer: Hummingbirds beat their wings up to 80 times per second and are the only birds able to fly backwards.

title: Penguins
answer: Emperor penguins survive -60°C winters by huddling in rotating formations, and males incubate the single egg for up to 4 months without eating.

title: Earth
answer: Earth is the third planet from the Sun — the only known world with liquid surface water and plate tectonics.

title: Moon
answer: The Moon is drifting away from Earth at about 3.8 cm per year, slowly lengthening our days.

title: HAZOOM OS
answer: HAZOOM OS is a full desktop operating system in the browser — kernel, apps, services, consciousness engine, Q-learning, and a GitHub bridge, all in one repo.

title: GitHub bridge
answer: The GitHub bridge receives webhooks, verifies signatures with HMAC-SHA256, runs gated GitOps commands from ops/commands.json on every push, and broadcasts events to the OS over WebSockets.

title: Dev farm
answer: The dev farm is a Juju model with 6 LXD machines, each hosting a cloned repo for a microservice, registered in Kubernetes under the hazoom-dev namespace.

title: Shell gating
answer: The OS shell is gated by an allowlist: git operations, process inspection, and system info are allowed; destructive commands are denied with reason codes.
